content: Official football-data.org docs expose CL competition matches, standings, and teams using X-Auth-Token; free coverage lists Champions League, delayed scores and schedules, tables, and 10 calls per minute. Match records include stable numeric IDs, UTC date, status, matchday, stage, lastUpdated, teams, and scores. Nulls and empty lists are valid, so completeness cannot be inferred from HTTP 200 alone. Terms and retention/display rights still need owner review.
